== Missing data: Top 8 finishes ==
The Players Committee deck posts tagged "Top 8" (Drew Lichtenstein, Justin Miyashiro, Matt Sokol, Mike d'Amboise, Mike Kessling) give no finishing positions, so their Top 8 rows show "—". The lead names [[Drew Lichtenstein]] as the winner, while the Top 8 table lists [[Eric Hunter Top 8]] at 1; the full Top 8 order needs a source (the PC event page). Mike Kessling's Top 8 Dark Side list was posted twice (23 and 24 January 2022) with identical cards; both posts are cited on one page. No Top 8 Light Side post exists for Drew Lichtenstein or Matt Sokol.

== PC Discord and Retro Club facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added the in-person venue, the early-registration bonus and the alternate-image foil prize, from the Players Committee wrap-up, the forum event thread and two Discord posts (Solidsnack3 in #cantina, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (10 December 2021), [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469157587025922/918856044984270908 Discord message]; JaredNap in #open-deck-discussion, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (29 July 2022), [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/813119516652601414/1002724028907266129 Discord message]).
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The lead says the event was "on GEMP", and the Format list gives '''Site:''' GEMP; the [[List of SWCCG tournaments]] row also gives GEMP as the site. The Players Committee wrap-up says: "The event was held in-person at the Heldrich Hotel in New Brunswick, New Jersey", and calls it "the first in-person iteration of the event since 2019" ([https://www.starwarsccg.org/drew-lichtenstein-wins-the-2022-match-play-championship/ Drew Lichtenstein Wins the 2022 Match Play Championship], starwarsccg.org, 28 January 2022; Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20220128204228/https://www.starwarsccg.org/drew-lichtenstein-wins-the-2022-match-play-championship/ Internet Archive]). The forum event thread gives the tournament address as The Heldrich Hotel & Conference Center, 10 Livingston Avenue, New Brunswick ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1358873#p1358873 imrahil327, 7 November 2021]; Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20211207205206/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=79488 Internet Archive]). The page's own game-room and keg photographs fit an in-person event. The existing GEMP wording was left in place; a human editor should correct the lead, the Site line and the List row.
* The wrap-up also says the Main Event had thirty players, Charlie Arlandson placed third and Mike D'amboise fourth, and Greg Shaw replaced Justin Desai in the Top 8. The Top 8 table shows Eric Hunter at 1 and the other finishes blank; these wrap-up places were not added in this edit.
